prompt.generated_prompt_string: Ultra-realistic cinematic chest-up portrait of a stylish adult woman standing in a crowded city street. She has a sleek short bob, natural makeup, realistic skin texture, and a glossy black high-fashion jacket with tailored trousers. Keep her sharply focused while pedestrians become soft motion blur. Surround her with abstract teal, cyan, magenta, and warm-orange city glows, heavy bokeh, shallow depth of field, teal-and-orange grading, and a fine rim light around her face. Shoot on a full-frame camera with an 85mm lens at f/1.4: moody cyberpunk street photography meets fashion editorial, with no readable signage or branding.
